structured_prompt:
SUBJECT
Macro product photography material study of matte B4C technical ceramic.

MATERIAL
Solid porcelain-white #FAFAFA surface. Exquisite eggshell microtexture. Highly detailed subtle hairline fractures and micro-cracks. Strictly zero specular highlights. Cold and dry industrial ceramic feel. Non-plastic, non-PVC, non-glossy, non-toy.

LIGHTING
Low-key cinematic. Precise shadows to define form and grain. No ambient color wash. No magenta spill. No neon.

COMPOSITION
Macro close-up. Clean negative space. Premium commercial readability. Material purity emphasis.

BACKGROUND
Brutalist minimal concrete surface.

QUALITY
Ultra-detailed 8K resolution. Industrial design aesthetic.
